description: This file defines the SecurityGroupMessage class, a model representing messages associated with security groups in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for metadata, database schema definitions, and methods for retrieving list view data, saving messages, and calculating time lapse since message creation.

classes.name: SecurityGroupMessage
classes.description: Represents messages linked to security groups, handling display logic and persistence within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for display in list views, including handling user permissions, retrieving associated security group and user info, and formatting message display.

methods.name: saveMessage
methods.description: Static method to save a new message associated with a security group, ensuring user permissions and sanitizing input.

methods.name: getTimeLapse
methods.description: Calculates and returns a human-readable string indicating how much time has passed since a given date.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether this bean implements specific interfaces, returning false for 'ACL'.
